name: direct_contact_tower_catalogue
title: Direct-contact cooling tower with catalogue data and nominal checks
summary: Direct-contact (open) cooling tower of the Laborelec 2002 toolkit: counter-flow exchanger between the water and the saturated exhaust air (fictitious fluid at the wet-bulb temperature), catalogue parameters and nominal values read from a B.A.C. lookup table, check procedures for the fooling factor, water flow and fan speed.

origin.source_path: ~/Nextcloud/thermo_models/modeles/LABORELEC_2002/2_Evaporative Equipments/2_2_Simulation Models - Diagram Window/Direct Contact Cooling Tower/Direct Contact Cooling Tower.EES
authors: Felipe Trebilcock (ULiege Thermodynamics Lab, Dec 2002, for Laborelec)
origin.course: Laborelec toolkit 2002 (evaporative equipment), EES Diagram-Window simulation model; catalogue table directcontactdata.LKT (candidate TM-0298)

verification.summary: Compared with the solution stored in the EES source file (60 records; the 15 kJ/kPa reference values converted x1000 by hand): 56 common variables, 16 differ above rtol = 0.001, maximum relative difference 3.97e-03 (omega_f_ct), all downstream of the humid-air property differences EES 6.596 vs CoolProp, as in CSL-0076 (4.51e-03).
verification.reference: EES stored solution of Direct Contact Cooling Tower.EES (ees_variables.csv; 4 stale variables of inactive Diagram-window modes and 7 string variables excluded)
verification.notes: 16 differences (max 3.97e-03 on omega_f_ct) all follow the humid-air property differences (h_a 2.3e-03, c_p_af 3.6e-03, c_w 4.3e-04); 40 algebraic results below 1e-03. Excluded: DELTAp_ct, rpm_fan, V_dot_a_ct_fan, V_dot_a_ct_rpm (inactive modes) and the 7 strings.
